gloss: far from it; on the contrary; if anything

definitions.gloss: far from it; on the contrary; if anything; what's more
definitions.explanation: Rejects what was just said or expected as falling short of the truth and introduces something more extreme, either in the opposite direction or further in the same direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|おこ}られなかった→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。それどころか、⟦{褒|ほ}められた→褒める：01204_homeru⟧。
examples.english: I wasn't scolded. On the contrary, I was praised.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{止|や}まない→止む：01153_yamu⟧。それどころか、⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: The rain isn't stopping. If anything, it's getting heavier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下|さ}がらなかった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。それどころか、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧になって⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: Even after taking medicine my fever didn't go down; worse, by night I had started coughing too.

notes:
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ + どころ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (far from). It begins a new sentence or clause and refers back to the previous statement: not only is that not so, the reality goes further. What follows is often surprising, and can be good or bad.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どころ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: far from — attaches to a word inside one sentence: ⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧どころ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧
- ⟦むしろ→むしろ：02364_mushiro⟧: rather — a gentler preference for one alternative
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even so — accepts the previous statement and goes on despite it
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: besides — simply adds, with no reversal
